title: Steve Luce's record and playing on Charters Street
summary: Nash recalls a pianist who recorded That Oughta Get It and played at the corner piano place on Toulouse and Charters.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Now you mentioned that all together. What is that like?

I think Steve Luce made a recorded record of that, That Oughta Get It. That's where they go. Did it have words on there? Yeah it had words too. I just can't remember. Steve Luce recorded a record of that. Used to play out here on Charler Street.
Around there on Charler Street. Used to play, I'll tell you where he played, right on Toulouse and Charler. You know where they got the piano in the corner place? Across from the restaurant?
You mean Victor's Ball right there?
That's right. That's what Steve Luce used to play. Is that right? That's right. He used to play that. That's been a long time.
